newsitem.title: CANADA: Dominion Bond confirms Hollinger ratings.
newsitem.headline: Dominion Bond confirms Hollinger ratings.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Friday it was confirming all ratings on Hollinger Inc debt and preferred shares.

DBRS said it confirmed Hollinger's Southam-linked convertible debentures at BB; its liquid yield option notes at BB (Low); its First DT Holdings Ltd shares at Pfd-4; its Premier U.K. NT Canadian/U.S. at Pfd-4.
All ratings were given a stable trend.
"DBRS is confirming the ratings of Hollinger Inc in light of the recent announcement to reorganize its Canadian publishing operations," the agency said.
